get.description: Health check endpoint

List work locations. Users with only list_own see their own; users with
the broad list permission see all.

post.description:
Employee submits a proposed work location. Always created as PENDING;
admin must approve before it can be used.

delete.description:
Employee deletes their own pending proposal. Approved/rejected
locations cannot be deleted here — admin handles that via force_delete.

patch.description:
Admin-only edit of location fields (radius, active flag, name, coords,
expiry, notes). Does not change approval status — use approve/reject for that.

get.description: Verify if current GPS is within range of approved work locations.
Admin: list all pending work location proposals awaiting review.

post.description:
Admin directly whitelists a location — skips pending and is immediately
APPROVED. Admin must supply allowed_radius_meters.
Admin approves a pending proposal. Optionally sets allowed_radius_meters.
Admin rejects a pending proposal with a reason.

delete.description: Admin deletes any work location regardless of status or owner.

post.description: Admin override of a location check on an attendance record.

get.description: Get available choices for estate invoice fields.
List all estate property invoices with filtering and search.

post.description:
Create a new estate property invoice with optional items and approvers.

If `approvers` is provided, the invoice is created as 'draft' and approval
steps are automatically created for each specified approver. Each approver
entry requires: user_id, step (order), and step_name.

If no approvers are provided and invoice_type is 'full-payment', the invoice
is sent directly to the client.

get.description:
List invoices pending the current user's approval.

Returns invoices where the current user is either:
- Specifically assigned to a pending approval step, OR
- Has the required level for a pending approval step (when no specific user is assigned)
  and all previous steps are already approved.
Get a specific estate property invoice by ID.

put.description: Update an existing estate property invoice.

post.description: Submit a draft invoice for approval. Creates the 2-step approval chain.
Approve or reject an approval step. Manager handles step 1, CEO handles step 2.
Record a client payment (partial or full). Updates amount_paid on the invoice.
